name: Mention tag
summary: Pill chip reading @name with a small generic avatar circle that pops in; for credits and shout-outs.

params.name: name
params.note: name without the @ (it is added); shrinks to fit

params.name: color
params.note: avatar colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

author: krakujs
